answer: During registration, two percent of new identities silently receive a second, different private prompt minutes after their first answer; accounts whose two responses drift apart by more than one style metric are frozen before they ever touch the ledger. A farm writing 500 dune of clones produces answers from one template pool, so its delta between paired prompts is huge and nearly every clone trips the check — walking it off the ledge. An honest agent writing each answer itself sees no second prompt at all and pays nothing.
